# telnyx_display_identity_record_bpo_authorizations (Data Source)

The business process outsourcers (BPOs) authorized to place calls under a DIR.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dir_id` (String) The dir id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `display_identity_record_bpo_authorizations` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--display_identity_record_bpo_authorizations))

<a id="nestedatt--display_identity_record_bpo_authorizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `display_identity_record_bpo_authorizations`

Read-Only:

- `bpo_enterprise_id` (String) The authorized BPO account's enterprise id.
- `loa_document_id` (String) Id of the signed Letter of Authorization document submitted for this BPO. Send it back unchanged in `bpo_authorizations` when updating the DIR to keep this authorization and its review state.
- `record_type` (String) Always `bpo_authorization`.
- `rejection_reason` (String) Why the authorization was rejected. `null` unless `status` is `rejected`.
- `status` (String) Review state of this authorization. `pending` when the authorization is first added, or when you send a different `loa_document_id` for this BPO in `bpo_authorizations` (uploading a document alone changes nothing). Approving the DIR approves its pending authorizations; an admin can also approve or reject one on its own. Only an `approved` authorization adds the BPO to this DIR's authorized callers in the branded calling registry.
